description: An oil-painting style scene. In the foreground a man in a flat cap and dark coat cranks or operates a large dark wooden box camera on a wooden tripod, looking to the side. Behind him a crowd of men in top hats and dark overcoats stands before a large white neoclassical building with tall columns. On the steps, a single man in a dark suit raises one arm while a row of people stands on the balcony. Dress and architecture look late 19th or early 20th century. No visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the image edge to edge.
